description: Fork of exp333. Keeps narrow input lookup (out_input_nap=6, table_dim=64) and partition_sets on out_proj, but bumps out_output_nap 32 -> 256. Restores out_proj bit-param budget to 16.8M/layer (half of exp329) by concentrating it in vote density rather than lookup granularity. Tests whether the exp333 regression came from input-side capacity loss vs overall bit-budget shrinkage.
